expected_title: A Multi-University Small Satellite Design Course : Systems Engineering Approach
abstract: to the support of Earth observation using systems of small satellites. Major outcomes of this course include that the students have the experience of working in multi-disciplinary, multi-university teams, practicing critical thinking skills, and managing the design of complex systems. In addition, the course was developed around utilizing Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) practices and tools throughout the design life-cycle while utilizing a common design language, Systems Modelling Language (SysML). The approach started with a mission idea and proceeded to a feasible concept that included requirements development and management, concept modeling and performance simulation, and prototype building using low-cost additive manufacturing techniques, ending with a “Shark-tank” style presentation.
